name: Long-Only Metals & Materials Momentum
description: Long-only cross-sectional momentum strategy on 10 US metals and materials stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, FCX, SCCO, AA, CENX, RS, ATI). Ranks by 6-month (126-day) rate of change, goes long the top 3, equal-weighted at ~33% per position, rebalanced monthly on the first trading day.
source:
# Long-Only Metals & Materials Momentum Strategy
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: 10 US metals/materials stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, FCX, SCCO, AA, CENX, RS, ATI)
# - Signal: 6-month momentum (126-day Rate of Change)
# - Selection: Long top 3 by momentum
# - Weighting: Equal weight (~33% per stock)
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# 6-month momentum (126 trading days)
momentum_6m = roc(period=126)(close)

# Cross-sectional selection: top 3 by momentum (long)
is_top_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(momentum_6m)

# Detect first trading day of month
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Monthly rebalance signals for LONG positions
enter_long = is_new_month and is_top_3
exit_long = is_new_month and not is_top_3
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# Entry zones (long-only)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# Equal weight across active long positions
weights = equal_weight()(held_long)

# Position sizing - rebalance on first trading day of month
# 3 active positions → ~33% each
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
